One Block of Long Results

Source: R/analysis_pipeline.R
ck_res_df.Rd

The single shape every branch of ck_fast_analysis returns. Scalars recycle, so a branch passes whichever of its arguments vary.

Usage

ck_res_df(type, avar, avalue, gvar, gvalue, stat, n, n_total, n_w, n_w_total)

Arguments

type, avar, avalue, gvar, gvalue

Key columns.

stat, n, n_total, n_w, n_w_total

Statistic columns.

Value

A dataframe with the ten long-format columns.
